**🚀 New release: v1.40.3**
https://github.com/SidNDeed/SidsCompetitiveRounds/releases/tag/v1.40.3

# v1.40.3

The region your ranked match is played in is measured properly again, plus two
fixes from your reports.

## The room your ranked match lands in

The room is meant to be chosen from both players' own Photon pings. In practice
those measurements were usually too old to count, and for some players they
never ran at all. Three separate things were wrong.

- **The refresh was slower than the deadline.** Your client only refreshed its
  ping map once it was older than 300 seconds, but the server refuses any map
  stamped more than 180 seconds before the room is created. Everything in that
  gap was measured, uploaded, and then thrown away. The threshold is now 60
  seconds.
- **Queueing from the menu could not refresh at all.** The one trigger that
  could refresh your map while you waited required being connected to Photon's
  master server - which you are not while sitting at the main menu, which is
  exactly where you queue from. That requirement is gone from the queue path.
- **Ranked-only players had nothing to measure.** Photon builds its region list
  from a request it makes only while no region is set, and joining a ranked room
  sets one before that ever happens. If you only queue ranked, the list never
  arrived, so the ping never ran once in the whole session. The mod now fetches
  its own copy of the list from Photon's name server when the game has not got
  one - a separate, short-lived connection that reads the list and closes.

**🚀 New release: v1.40.2**
https://github.com/SidNDeed/SidsCompetitiveRounds/releases/tag/v1.40.2

# v1.40.2

## MAIL

- A new Mail page: write to other players (up to 8 at a time, a subject and a
  2,000-character message), read, reply, copy, report, block and delete, with a
  toast and a tone when new mail arrives. Settings gains "Who can mail me"
  (everyone, or only players you have played) and a blocked-sender list.
- Mail and Music are icons now, at the top right above the tabs; the mail icon
  carries a red badge with your unread count. Each opens as a popup over the
  page instead of taking it over: Escape or a click outside closes it, the page
  underneath is untouched, and a half-written message survives closing and
  reopening.

## HOVER A NAME, SEE THE PLAYER

- Hover a player's name on the F5 page - the 1v1 ranked and casual history, the
  four leaderboards, the 1v2 boards and the leaderboard's selected player - and
  a mini-profile opens: name and title, tier, rating and level, online status,
  and your head-to-head in every mode, your last meeting, the current ranked
  streak and your net rating change against them. Click the name to pin the
  card; Escape or a click elsewhere closes it.

## SESSION REPORTS

- A Session button on the ranked, casual, 2v2, FFA and 1v2 history rows opens a
  per-game report of that sitting: damage and score over time, DPS, hit and
  block rates, ping and FPS, totals and builds. On the 1v1 rows there is one
  Session button per opponent per sitting, beside the ID button, on the newest
  game you played them in. A sitting is your finished games split wherever more
  than three hours passed between two of them, so playing someone else in
  between keeps it alive. Requires Steam sign-in; games recorded before
  telemetry show what exists.

**🚀 New release: v1.40.1**
https://github.com/SidNDeed/SidsCompetitiveRounds/releases/tag/v1.40.1

## Clavar la Bala: two more tracks

"Principio de Ronda" and "Nube Tóxica" join the album as tracks 13 and 14. Existing tracks are
unchanged and keep their ratings; the shop listing now says 14 tracks. The audio ships from a new
immutable asset revision (`music-ar3`) — the client fetches it once and caches it.

## Music: preparation at the main menu

Downloaded tracks are now decoded only inside an explicit main-menu click — a Music-tab control
such as Prepare or a track's Play, or the Shop's Preview — one track per click, and never while
your seat is joining a game. v1.40.0 could decode several just-downloaded tracks together around
the first card pick (320-700 ms each), which is the hitch some of you felt there.

The Music tab's Prepare button shows what is still pending. With Loop on (the default) a track
that ends before the next one is prepared repeats instead of going quiet, and a failed decode is
retried only by a click.

## Queue

The 1v1 queue poll now requires your own Steam session. A seat whose polls are refused for 30
seconds straight stops polling, says so, and lets the server clear the seat shortly after.

Match-making writes are now reciprocal: the room is issued only to a pair whose rows still name
each other, declining a pre-room match frees the partner, and a pair that no longer matches
dissolves only the caller's row — the client is told and goes back to searching by itself.
